body.statement: Uniformly over \(\mathcal M_{T_0,T_1}(0)\), \(\mathbb E_\vartheta\|S_0-(UD^2U^{\top}+\sigma^2I_N)\|_F^2=[2(N+1)\sigma^2\operatorname{tr}(D^2)+N(N+1)\sigma^4]/T_0\). The gap between the \(r\)-dimensional signal eigenspace and the noise eigenspace is at least \(d_{\mathrm{lo}}^2\), even when loading strengths repeat. Consequently, \(\Pr_\vartheta\{P\in\mathcal K_0(Y_0)\}\ge1-\alpha/2\), \(\mathbb E_\vartheta\|\widehat P-P\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le\min\{1,2\sqrt{V_0/T_0}/d_{\mathrm{lo}}^2\}\), and \(\mathbb E_\vartheta\|\widehat P-P\|_{\mathrm{op}}^2\le\min\{1,4V_0/(T_0d_{\mathrm{lo}}^4)\}\). No eigengap among the nonzero eigenvalues is required.
body.justification: The nuisance subspace rate is derived from the deterministic-factor Gaussian primitives using only the signal-versus-noise gap \(d_{\mathrm{lo}}^2\).
body.gap: NaumovSpokoinyUlyanov2017 treats centered i.i.d. covariance observations and bootstrap projector loss; the displayed identity is for a deterministic normalized factor array with additive Gaussian panel noise.
body.consumer: It gives the finite-sample geometry input needed by any full-panel interference interval that propagates loading uncertainty.
